endorsements.quote: At present, foundation models or intelligent agents are developed on mainstream populations excluding highaltitude populations, so MSI agents need to be validated on high-altitude scenarios before being deployed.
Adequate discourse spanning the AI lifecycle is necessary to guide development considerations as well as improve understanding which can make it easy to adapt these technologies.

unlisted_practices: Develop governance structures, including criteria for retiring harmful or unhelpful agents, to ensure AI agents promote health equity.
Establish community governance over AI, including co-developed acceptable-risk thresholds, approval rights for updates, and the ability to pause deployment.
Use an auditable deployment design with automated monitoring, periodic human review, and explicit escalation and decommissioning criteria in resource-constrained settings.
Log all inputs, intermediate artifacts, retrieval sources, uncertainty and outputs of agentic AI for auditing.
Begin agentic AI deployment with a narrowly scoped pilot in a strictly constrained workflow to validate data pathways, auditability and governance before scaling.
Provide explicit uncertainty estimates and traceable evidence links with AI recommendations.
Simplify the process of verifying AI agent outputs so that solitary clinicians can check them.
Build multi-site, federated or consortium datasets under shared governance with harmonized metadata capturing altitude exposure and environmental context.
Establish community-governed data stewardship and consent, respecting data sovereignty and indigenous knowledge.
Evaluate AI using community-relevant outcomes such as missed diagnosis rates, access, feasibility and health impact rather than solely paper-oriented metrics.
Perform counterfactual testing and retrieval-provenance audits of altitude-aware AI components.
Test AI for out-of-distribution detection and flag out-of-distribution inputs.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/viewpoint paper discussing opportunities and challenges for agentic AI and generalist foundation models in high-altitude healthcare equity, rather than an empirical study.
